status.en: 183 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 21% more than the week before, most of them in Islamabad, Balochistan and Kabul.
status.nb: 183 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 21 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Belutsjistan og Kabul.

summary.en: Taliban forces opened fire on Pakistani security forces along the Kurram border, killing a Pakistani officer and several militants in Balochistan. Pakistan has suspended trade at two Iran border crossings and a dispute over the Zangali checkpost is disrupting operations at the Torkham crossing while advancing a defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey. The United Nations warns Afghanistan is one step away from famine and the Taliban opened a road to China that faces security hurdles. The Taliban released 291 Afghan citizens from Pakistani prisons and a Taliban member was killed in Takhar. 1,794 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Taliban-styrker skjøt mot pakistanske sikkerhetsstyrker langs Kurram-grensen, og drepte en pakistansk offiser og flere militante i Balochistan. Pakistan har stanset handelen ved to grenseoverganger mot Iran, og en tvist om Zangali-kontrollpost forstyrrer operasjonene ved Torkham-overgangen mens landet fremmer en forsvarspakt med Saudi-Arabia og Tyrkia. FN advarer om at Afghanistan er ett skritt fra hungersnød, og Taliban har åpnet en vei til Kina som møter sikkerhetsutfordringer. Taliban løslatte 291 afghanske borgere fra pakistanske fengsler, og et Taliban-medlem ble drept i Takhar. 1 794 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
